immutable_rule: Any path bound by a historical frozen manifest/contract remains immutable. Every shipped path not classified as protected parent must be explicitly classified in the exact v0.11 successor ownership universe; no unclassified package path is permitted.

protected_parent_selector.rule: Union of every versions/v0.10/MANIFEST.json content_hashes key plus protected_release_manifests, with protected-parent precedence over successor ownership.

successor_classification_rule: Every shipped package path not in the protected-parent selector must appear exactly once in SUCCESSOR-OWNERSHIP-UNIVERSE.json and classifies as MUTABLE_SUCCESSOR. This includes root PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json and successor-owned root docs/prompts/roadmap/evaluation files.
evidence_preservation_override: MUTABLE_SUCCESSOR is an ownership/boundary class, not blanket write permission. Hash-preserved independent-review source artifacts remain write-prohibited by their evidence-preservation obligations.
explicitly_not_authorized: silently add a shipped path without regenerating the exact successor ownership universe
append to shared frozen/hash-locked canonical docs merely for convenience
